kv_formats: supported fused K/V strided page views
supported_shape_facts.support_unit: 128-token block selected by ascending int32 q2k_indices[Hkv,total_q,topk], -1 tail padded

compatibility_decision: Qwen GQA4/8 BF16 D128 arithmetic is supported. The selected block granularity cannot express current arbitrary token supports on the unchanged physical source. No per-token mask parameter exists. Enlarging a selected block changes attention and is not an exact-mask baseline.
possible_separate_adapter: Gather each head/request selected K/V into contiguous ragged histories, then select their packed blocks and preserve exact valid lengths. This would be an E0 adapter with necessary payload copying/preparation timed; it is not a no-copy same-source counterpart. No such GPU performance qualification is claimed here.
scope: Read-only API/source and CPU mask-granularity audit. No GPU probe or SM120 performance claim for MSA.
